description: NIFS Large Helical Device (LHD) Experiment is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "energy", published or maintained by NIFS. The Large Helical Device (LHD), owned and operated by the National Institute for Fusion Science (NIFS), is one of the world's largest plasma confinement device which employs a heliotron magnetic configuration generated by the superconducting coils. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag energy and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Archived data files are updated nightly when new or revised data are generated in LHD experiment. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "This data is available for anyone to use under the " Rights and Terms" on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
